hotel.name: Matild Palace,a Luxury Collection Hotel, Budapest

verified_facts.text: The palace was originally conceived in 1902 by Archduchess Maria Klotild of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha as twin Baroque palaces flanking the Elisabeth Bridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: originally conceived in 1902 by Archduchess Maria Klotild of Saxe‑Coburg and Gotha as twin Baroque palaces flanking the Elisabeth Bridge

verified_facts.text: After a meticulous restoration, it reopened as a Luxury Collection hotel in 2021, blending Austro-Hungarian grandeur with contemporary refinement.
verified_facts.excerpt: Now reborn as a Luxury Collection hotel after meticulous restoration in 2021, it blends Austro‑Hungarian grandeur with contemporary refinement

verified_facts.text: The twin Baroque palaces were designed by the architects Giergl and Korb.
verified_facts.excerpt: Duchess Maria Klotild envisioned twin Baroque palaces - crafted by architects Giergl and Korb - as a grand gateway to Pest.

verified_facts.text: The palace was home to the Belvarosi Kavehaz cafe, a Belle Epoque haven for artists and thinkers, where Gyula Krudy found inspiration for his character Sindbad.
verified_facts.excerpt: At its heart was the iconic Belvárosi Kávéház, a Belle Époque haven for artists and thinkers. Among them was Gyula Krúdy, who found inspiration here for his famed character, Sindbad,

verified_facts.text: The hotel is at Vaci utca 36 in central Budapest.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vaci Utca 36, Budapest, Hungary, 1056

verified_facts.text: Rooms have headboards with Hungarian handcrafting, Hungarian fishbone parquet floors and artwork referencing Budapest literature.
verified_facts.excerpt: headboards with Hungarian handcrafting, Hungarian style fish bone design parquet floors and artwork referencing Budapest

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms are inspired by Hungarian thermal bath culture, with mosaic tiles and marble surfaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the Hungarian thermal bath culture, each bathroom is adorned with vibrant mosaic tiles, sleek marble surfaces, and refined finishes that evoke the grandeur of Budapest's Belle Époque.

verified_facts.text: Every guest room has the Andrea Collection bed linens by Frette.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each guestroom features the exclusive Andrea Collection by Frette

verified_facts.text: The suites include the Crown Tower Suite and the Maria Klotild Royal Suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: suites including the Crown Tower Suite and Maria Klotild Royal Suite

verified_facts.text: Rooms offer Danube River views, and there are family-friendly connecting rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: spectacular Danube river views, and the convenience of family friendly connecting rooms

verified_facts.text: The interiors balance old-world charm and classic Art Nouveau features with a heritage palette of teal, gold and copper.
verified_facts.excerpt: classic art nouveau features and a modern new world. Highlighted with an inspiring yet calming heritage colour palette incorporating striking pops of teal, gold and copper.

verified_facts.text: Ocean Spa offers traditional thermal therapies and Hammam rituals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Traditional thermal therapy and Hammam rituals designed to awaken the senses and purify the mind, body, and soul.

verified_facts.text: Ocean Spa treatments use ESPA products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulgent treatments powered by ESPA products

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments use indigenous Hungarian ingredients and products.
verified_facts.excerpt: carefully designed treatments, using indigenous Hungarian ingredients and products.

verified_facts.text: Ocean Spa is inspired by the tranquility and beauty of the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the tranquility and beauty of the sea, this exclusive spa combines the elegance of Matild Palace

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is open to guests 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Fitness Center is open to guests 24 hours day, and is fitted with the latest fitness equipment.

verified_facts.text: Spago by Wolfgang Puck Budapest is the European debut of Puck's Beverly Hills restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spago by Wolfgang Puck Budapest is the long-awaited European debut of Puck’s renowned Beverly Hills restaurant

verified_facts.text: Spago serves Californian cuisine with Hungarian and global accents.
verified_facts.excerpt: Puck’s signature and seasonal menu of Californian cuisine with Hungarian and global accents

verified_facts.text: The Duchess is a secret liquor library and rooftop bar with panoramic views, reached through a hidden entrance of private elevators.

verified_facts.text: Cova Budapest, from the Milanese cafe house founded in 1817, offers all-day dining and aperitivo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since 1817, Cova has defined Milanese café culture, offering all-day dining, refined mornings, elegant afternoons, and aperitivo.

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds a MICHELIN 2 Key Hotel distinction for 2025.

verified_facts.text: All members of the concierge team wear the gilt keys of Les Clefs d'Or.

verified_facts.text: Curated tours include a Danube cruise by Dunarama aboard a mahogany water limousine.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers tailored private walking tours of Budapest.
verified_facts.excerpt: Uncover Budapest’s architectural elegance and rich heritage on a tailored private walking tour.
